## The four fixes

- **#32955 (non-admin meta 404 on sys_approval_request) — fixed.** Ada Auditor (plain member) reached the inbox through the account app and opened EXP-2001 by its Request cell: the console's `GET /api/v1/meta/object/sys_approval_request` → **200** (404 before 8004529e), the request and `/actions` reads 200, no "Object Not Found", and the page drew [Approve, Reject, Reassign, Send back, Request info, Reply] against her flags {can_act:true, is_submitter:false, can_override:false}. Mei (non-admin submitter): meta 200, [Send reminder, Recall, Reply]. Rows stay gated: Ada's `/data/sys_approval_request` 403; a member with no request still gets 404 on the meta read, by the fix's design. #33048's A0–A2 now pass.
- **#32754 (member attach to own record) — fixed.** A contributor member holding no app grant on sys_attachment attached to their own invoice through both doors: presign → PUT → `upload/complete` with attachTo 200 (attachmentId returned); MCP `create_upload_link` with attachments:true, spending the link 200, a second use 404. The grant is the `storage_attachment_member` additive baseline (ADR-0090 D5): read + create, explain says delete false. Negatives hold: a record the member cannot read (INV-1003) → 403 ATTACHMENT_PARENT_ACCESS (MCP link: RECORD_NOT_FOUND); a record Mei reads but cannot edit (showcase_project) → 403 ATTACHMENT_PARENT_ACCESS on upload/complete, the MCP link and a raw `POST /data/sys_attachment`; admin read-back 0 rows on both; FILES_DISABLED still applies on an owned record without `enable.files`.
- **#32986 (unregistering the host package keeps environment rows) and #33003 (a rewrite keeps the env-row mark) — partial.** The card's precondition is not producible on any stock boot at this sha: `os dev` builds MetadataPlugin from the compiled artifact with no `packageId` (`packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts` ≈L3760; serve's host-config door and the standalone stack have the same shape), so `_loadFromFileSystem`, the only pass that stamps rows, never runs; the manager has no DatabaseLoader on these boots; and nothing first-party calls `MetadataManager.unregisterPackage` (the fix PR says so too). Measured: after a reboot the env rows were not in the manager's registry and the env object carried `_packageId:'sys_metadata'`, not the host. With the probe plugin, `unregisterPackage(host)` kept all 6 env rows (object, draft object, view, dashboard, app, hook) in process and after a reboot, while the host's own items left the registry as the control expects; the host's REST publish/revert refuse (422 WRITABLE_PACKAGE_REQUIRED) and in-process publish/revert wrote nothing and stamped no stored body. The late-manifest bridge leg (#33003) is not-run: the install door refuses `objectExtensions` (400) and the offline boot offers no marketplace install. Because no row is ever stamped, the live result cannot tell the fix from its parent. Supporting evidence: the fixes' own new tests pass at 8e3d4a54 — metadata `database-loader.test.ts -t "32986|33003"` 31 passed, objectql `plugin-late-bridge-environment-row.test.ts` 3 passed.
  **For the PM:** the data-loss path these two p0s guard is not reachable from `os dev`, `os serve` or the standalone stack; it needs a host that builds `MetadataPlugin({packageId})` in eager mode with a DatabaseLoader and calls `unregisterPackage` itself (a hosted runtime outside this repo, if any).

Per-item checklist-accuracy notes follow.

**approvals.inbox-metadata-actions**
1. A1.verify says the dev admin on "that same pending request" (EXP-2001 in fixtures.requires[2]) sees 'Override Recall'. EXP-2001 also routes the dev admin through its manager group, so while that slot is open the admin has can_act:true. In that state the console draws plain "Recall" by design: `isOverrideDecision` requires an override-ONLY viewer (ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/approvalOverride.ts). The 'Override …' labels appear only once the admin holds no slot. I measured them after the a…
2. A3.verify names the network literal "POSTs /api/v1/approvals/requests/:id/approve" (and /:id/remind). Since objectstack#27611 (ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/apiActionDoor.ts), a declared same-origin `type:'api'` action posts to the action door, POST /api/v1/actions/sys_approval_request/<action>, and the server forwards it to the declared target. This is a stale spec. Suggested fix: name the action door, or say "the action door, forwarding to the declared target".
3. Fixture note: Ada's view had no "Override …" labels, as expected for a plain member, so rev 8's choice of Ada as the ready-made persona holds.

**studio-authoring.multi-package-item-rows**
- steps[4]'s ⛔ note says POST /api/v1/packages/A/publish answers 200 {success:false, itemsPublished:0, 'No metadata items found …'} for a Studio package. At 8e3d4a54 it answered 200 {success:true, packageId:'com.qa.afixa', version:1, itemsPublished:1} (driven after the A4 leg). The note's reason to prefer publish-drafts may still hold, but the measured answer it quotes is stale. Re-read packages/metadata/src/metadata-manager.ts publishPackage / collectPackageMembers.
- acceptance[1].verify reads "GET /meta/dashboard/qa_shared_dash/layers before/after". While two packages hold the name, that package-less layered read itself answers 409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT ("Name the package this layered read is for …"). The before/after evidence needs `layers?package=A` and `?package=B`. Suggest the verify say so.
